watch.summary: The streamer tries to keep a calm composure while controlling a fragile rolling egg, but panics and screams as it tumbles off a ledge and cracks.

beats.what: Streamer tells himself to relax while balancing the egg.
The egg wobbles unpredictable near the edge as the streamer repeatedly mutters 'wait a minute'.
The egg rolls off the platform into open air.
Streamer screams in panic as the egg falls and cracks on the ground.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The contrast between the streamer's gentle muttering to stay calm and his sudden desperate scream as the clumsy egg physics send it falling makes for a quick, relatable comedy fail.
